note: ORIGINAL = local executable-form files (real absolute paths, kept private, not published). PUBLISHED = path-redacted renderings in files/. Redaction maps: <run root> -> /LV/<run id>, nvm directory -> /NVM, home -> /HOME. The published bytes are NOT the original bytes except manifest.json (identical). check.py in the published copy pins the ORIGINAL launcher sha256 (78e28231...), which a published launcher does not satisfy; a future sealed executable original must be reviewed from the original seals below.
